(deflisten workspaces_data :initial "[]" "scripts/workspaces.sh")
(deflisten window_title :initial "..." "sh -c 'socat -u UNIX-CONNECT:$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/hypr/$HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE/.socket2.sock - | stdbuf -o0 sed -n \"s/^activewindow>>//p\" | stdbuf -o0 cut -d, -f2'")
(deflisten volume :initial "0" "scripts/volume.sh")
(deflisten layout :initial "en" "scripts/layout.sh")

(defpoll time :interval "10s" "date '+%H:%M'")
(defpoll gpu_temp :interval "2s" "sensors | grep -m1 'edge' | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '+°C' || echo 0")

(defwidget workspaces []
  (box :class "module-ws" :spacing 5 :space-evenly false
    (for ws in workspaces_data
      (button :onclick "hyprctl dispatch workspace ${ws.id}"
        (label :text "" :class {ws.active ? "active" : "inactive"})))))

(defwidget window_w []
  (box :class "module-win" :visible {window_title != ""}
    (label :text "${window_title}" :limit-width 50)))

(defwidget sidestuff []
  (box :class "module-stats" :spacing 5 :space-evenly false
    (label :text "󰢮 ${gpu_temp}°C" :class "gpu")
    (label :text "󰻠 ${round(EWW_CPU.avg, 0)}%" :class "cpu")
    (label :text "󰍛 ${round(EWW_RAM.used_mem_perc, 0)}%" :class "ram")
    (label :text {volume == "mute" ? "󰝟" : "󰕾 ${volume}%"} :class "vol")
    (label :text "󰌌 ${layout}" :class "layout")
    (label :text "󱑒 ${time}" :class "time")))

(defwidget bar []
  (centerbox :class "bar-container"
    (box :halign "start" (workspaces))
    (box :halign "center" (window_w))
    (box :halign "end" (sidestuff))))

(defwindow bar
  :monitor 0
  :geometry (geometry :x "0%" :y "8px" :width "99%" :height "36px" :anchor "top center")
  :stacking "fg"
  :exclusive true
  (bar))
files.scripts/volume.sh:
#!/bin/bash

get_vol() {
    data=$(wpctl get-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@)
    if echo "$data" | grep -q "\[MUTED\]"; then
        echo "mute"
    else
        echo "$data" | awk '{print int($2 * 100)}'
    fi
}

get_vol
pactl subscribe | stdbuf -oL grep --line-buffered "sink" | while read -r line; do
    get_vol
done
